{{Quote|Hi ZeeZee... Gosh, I see you did a ''great'' job of taking care of the place while I was gone.|Han Solo, commenting on ZZ-4Z's failure to keep his apartment tidy|<ref name="Dark Empire 3" />}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] acquired an '''apartment''' located within the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Solo frequently stopped over at the apartment along with his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] whilst visiting Nar Shaddaa, though after Solo embarked on a relationship with the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Salla Zend]], he often stayed at Zend's residence instead, and he allowed his associate [[Jarik Solo]] to stay at the apartment in his absence, to keep Chewbacca company.<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> After Solo won the [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|housekeeping droid]] [[ZZ-4Z]] from the smuggler [[Mako Spince]] in a card game, Solo tasked the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with maintaining his apartment, though he soon found the droid to be a nuisance that hindered his efforts to keep the apartment tidy.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>

Solo later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and left his career as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and he abandoned his apartment for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In his absence, ZZ-4Z failed to keep the apartment clean. During [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Solo ventured back to the apartment accompanied by his wife [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], hoping to pick up some [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] that he had kept stashed there. However, Mako Spince betrayed his former friend by informing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]&mdash;who hoped to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that had been placed on Solo's head by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]&mdash;that Solo was on Nar Shaddaa, and Spince and the two [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] subsequently staked out the apartment, waiting for Solo to arrive. When Solo and his spouse entered the apartment, a firefight quickly broke out between the Solos and the bounty hunters. ZZ-4Z was destroyed in the crossfire and the Solos then fled out onto the streets of Nar Shaddaa, with Dengar and Fett in hot pursuit.<ref name="Dark Empire 3" />
